body.zh-Hant: 汪兆銘是廣東番禺縣人，另以汪精衛之名著稱。德國國家圖書館權威檔記他生於1883年5月4日、卒於1944年11月10日，職業標為政治家。平凡社《世界大百科事典》的條目說，他留學日本法政大學時加入中國同盟會，並一度編輯機關誌《民報》。1910年他刺殺清朝攝政王載灃未遂，被判死刑，辛亥革命成功後獲釋。
body.en: Wang Zhaoming came from Panyu county in Guangdong and is also known by the name Wang Jingwei. The German National Library authority record gives his birth as 4 May 1883 and his death as 10 November 1944, and lists him as a politician. The Heibonsha encyclopedia entry says he joined the Chinese Revolutionary Alliance while studying at Hosei University in Japan and for a time edited its organ Minbao. In 1910 his attempt on the Qing prince regent Zaifeng failed and he was sentenced to death, but he was released when the 1911 revolution succeeded.

heading.en: KMT leader and the Executive Yuan

body.zh-Hant: 木山英雄的條目說，孫文去世後汪兆銘仍是代表左派的領袖；他在反蔣運動與流亡之間反覆，仍歷任行政院長、外交部長、黨副總裁等要職。張皓的論文記載，1935年夏日軍製造胡恩溥、白逾桓事件，強迫國民政府接受《何梅協定》，黨內出現要求他辭去行政院長兼外長的呼聲，他赴青島「療養」後提出辭職。11月1日起召開四屆六中全會，汪在開幕之日被槍傷。12月16日蔣介石宣誓就任行政院長時說，汪前院長健康尚未恢復。
body.en: According to Kiyama Hideo's entry, after Sun Yat-sen died Wang remained the leading figure of the left wing, and although he alternated between anti-Chiang activity and exile he held senior posts including president of the Executive Yuan, foreign minister and deputy party leader. Zhang Hao's article records that in summer 1935 Japan staged the Hu Enpu and Bai Yuhuan incidents and forced the government to accept the He-Umezu agreement, that calls arose within the party for him to give up the premiership and foreign ministry, and that he went to Qingdao to recuperate and then offered his resignation. The Fourth Plenum opened on 1 November, the day Wang was shot, and when Chiang Kai-shek took the oath as premier on 16 December he said Wang's health had not yet recovered.

citations.quote: 孫文亡き後も左派を代表する指導者として
以後反蔣運動や下野亡命を繰り返しながらも行政院長，外交部長，党副総裁などの要職を歴任した

body.zh-Hant: 張皓的論文說，1937年1月汪精衛返國，14日抵上海，18日趕到南京，並在1月23日行政院等機關的歡迎會上演說反對獨裁。木山英雄的條目說，他在1938年12月離開戰時首都重慶，1940年在日本佔領下的南京成立所謂「新中央政府」，1944年在名古屋去世。
body.en: Zhang Hao's article says that Wang came back to China in January 1937, reaching Shanghai on the 14th and Nanjing on the 18th, and on 23 January spoke at a welcome meeting of the Executive Yuan and other bodies against dictatorship. Kiyama Hideo's entry says that in December 1938 he left Chongqing, the wartime capital, that in 1940 he set up the so-called new central government in occupied Nanjing, and that he died in Nagoya in 1944.

people.name: Hryhorii Petrovsky
people.nameZh: 格里戈里·彼得羅夫斯基

body.zh-Hant: 《當代烏克蘭百科全書》（作者莫夫昌）說，彼得羅夫斯基生於1878年（新曆2月4日），出生地記為哈爾科夫，另有資料記為佩切尼吉村。他在葉卡捷琳諾斯拉夫、哈爾科夫等地的工廠做工，1895年投身革命運動。1912年他當選俄羅斯帝國第四屆國家杜馬議員，並領導布爾什維克黨團。
body.en: The Encyclopedia of Modern Ukraine, in an entry by O. M. Movchan, gives Petrovsky's birth as 1878 (4 February new style), in Kharkiv, though other data name the village of Pechenihy. He worked in factories in Katerynoslav, Kharkiv and other places and joined the revolutionary movement in 1895. In 1912 he was elected a deputy of the Fourth State Duma of the Russian Empire and led the Bolshevik faction.

citations.quote: (23. 01(04. 02). 1878, Харків, за ін. даними — с. Печеніги
Працював на заводах Катеринослава (нині Дніпро), Харкова,
1895 приєднався до революційного руху
У 1912 обраний депутатом 4-ї Державної думи Російської імперії
очолив більшовицьку фракцію

body.zh-Hant: 來源說，他1913年被增補為俄社民工黨中央委員，1914年被捕並流放東西伯利亞，1917年6月回到彼得格勒。1917年11月至1919年3月，他任俄羅斯蘇維埃聯邦社會主義共和國內務人民委員；1918年3月3日他參與簽署與四國同盟國的《布列斯特和約》。
body.en: The source says he was co-opted to the Central Committee of the RSDLP in 1913, was arrested and exiled to eastern Siberia in 1914, and returned to Petrograd in June 1917. From November 1917 to March 1919 he was people's commissar of internal affairs of the RSFSR, and on 3 March 1918 he took part in signing the Brest-Litovsk treaty with the Quadruple Alliance.

citations.quote: 1913 кооптований до ЦК РСДРП
1914 заарештований і засланий до Східного Сибіру
У червні 1917 повернувся до Петрограда
У листопаді 1917 — березні 1919 — нарком внутрішніх справ РСФРР
Брав участь у підписанні Брестського мирного договору РСФРР
з державами Четверного союзу 3 березня 1918

body.zh-Hant: 1919年3月，他被選為全烏克蘭中央執行委員會主席；1919年12月至1920年2月任全烏克蘭革命委員會主席，1920至1933年任全烏克蘭中央貧農委員會主席。他1920至1938年是烏共（布）中央政治局委員，1921至1939年同時是俄共（布）／全蘇共（布）中央委員，1926至1929年為全蘇共（布）中央政治局候補委員，1922年起任蘇聯中央執行委員會副主席。
body.en: In March 1919 he was elected chairman of the All-Ukrainian Central Executive Committee; from December 1919 to February 1920 he chaired the All-Ukrainian Revolutionary Committee, and from 1920 to 1933 the All-Ukrainian Central Committee of Poor Peasants. He was a member of the Politburo of the CP(B)U in 1920-38 and also of the Central Committee of the RCP(B)/VKP(B) in 1921-39, a candidate member of the VKP(B) Politburo in 1926-29, and from 1922 a deputy chairman of the USSR Central Executive Committee.

body.zh-Hant: 來源說，他在1938年被免去全烏克蘭中央執行委員會主席職務並被召回莫斯科。1939年聯共（布）十八大上，有人宣布他與「人民公敵」科西奧爾有牽連。他1940年起任莫斯科革命博物館的副館長（管理經營事務），史達林死後獲平反，1958年1月9日在莫斯科去世。
body.en: The source says that in 1938 he was removed as chairman of the All-Ukrainian Central Executive Committee and recalled to Moscow. At the 18th Congress of the VKP(B) in 1939 it was announced that he was linked to S. Kosior, an 'enemy of the people'. From 1940 he was deputy director for administration of the Museum of the Revolution in Moscow, he was rehabilitated after Stalin's death, and he died in Moscow on 9 January 1958.

body.zh-Hant: 《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科全書》（作者埃爾南德斯）說，門迭塔1873年11月4日出生，在獨立戰爭中是上校，戰後做了二十多年的國會議員，1916年又是副總統候選人。
body.en: The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, in an entry by José M. Hernández, says Mendieta was born on 4 November 1873, was a colonel in the war of independence, afterwards sat in congress for more than twenty years, and was a vice-presidential candidate in 1916.

citations.quote: Carlos Mendieta y Montefur ( b. 4 November 1873
A colonel in the war of independence
afterward a congressman for more than twenty years
Mendieta was also a vice presidential candidate in 1916

body.zh-Hant: 同一條目說，他在三年後（1919年）成為《古巴先驅報》的編輯，以好鬥的政治記者聞名。來源又說，他一般被視為正直的人，長期被許多人看成共和國的「希望」。
body.en: The same entry says that three years later, in 1919, he became editor of Heraldo de Cuba and won considerable fame as a combative political journalist. It adds that he was generally regarded as an honest man and was long held by many to be the hope of the Republic.

citations.quote: Three years later he became editor of Heraldo de Cuba
citations.evidenceNote: 1919 由同條目「vice presidential candidate in 1916」後三年推得（推論）

citations.quote: he achieved considerable fame as a combative political journalist
He was generally regarded as an honest man
for a long time he was held by many to be the "hope of the Republic,"

body.zh-Hant: 來源說，陸軍首長巴蒂斯塔於1934年1月18日任命他為古巴臨時總統。該條目評他是軟弱無能、被稱為巴蒂斯塔傀儡的總統；任內一場反政府總罷工遭軍方鎮壓。1934年5月29日古美簽訂條約，廢止《普拉特修正案》。美國國務院文獻說，後來出任他政府國務卿的科斯梅·德·拉·托列恩特主持了1934年條約的談判。條目說他於1935年12月10日辭職。
body.en: The source says army chief Batista appointed him Cuba's provisional president on 18 January 1934. The entry judges him an inept and weak president, dubbed Batista's puppet, and says a general strike against the government was harshly repressed by the military during his term. On 29 May 1934 a treaty with the United States abrogated the Platt Amendment. A State Department document says Cosme de la Torriente, who later became Secretary of State in the Mendieta government, directed the Cuban negotiations for the 1934 treaty. The entry says Mendieta resigned on 10 December 1935.

citations.quote: army chief Fulgencio Batista
Batista appointed him Cuba's provisional president on 18 January 1934
Mendieta proved to be an inept and weak president
he was quickly dubbed Batista's puppet
During his brief term in office
a general strike against the government was harshly repressed by the military

finally abrogated by a treaty signed with the United States on 29 May 1934

Secretary of State in the Mendieta Government

名單5442 迄日1935-12-11；Hernández 條目寫辭職日 1935-12-10（辭職日不一定等於卸任日）；古巴 Oficina del Historiador 的 Barnet 傳記（PDF 雙欄版面，無法逐字引用）也寫 1935-12-10 起由 Barnet 接任。未有兩份可逐字引用的 A／B 來源互相矛盾，故不列 conflict。
